verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page explicitly lists "Schedule recurring tasks" alongside creating campaigns and flows, so the product makes a first-party claim to recurring scheduling. That is only a single terse mention, and the documented automations/flows are event-triggered rather than recurring schedules, so they don't add credit for the recurring part. Missing for 10: documentation of how recurring schedules are defined (cadence, cron-like options, management), API or MCP access to create and manage recurring jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
